Because the karst weight is recomputed from the hollow history each close, the canyon audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 7 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 38% of full weight. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
